value.body: A backend developer builds the server-side part of software: the APIs, databases and business logic that apps and websites run on. Employers include IT services firms, product companies, startups, banks and in-house tech teams. A typical day involves writing and reviewing code, fixing bugs, working with databases, and coordinating with frontend and testing teams.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: B.Tech CSE/IT, BCA, B.Sc Computer Science or MCA

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Java, Python, Node.js or Go; SQL databases; Git; cloud platforms

items.label: India tech industry workforce
items.note: All tech roles, not only backend

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Most freshers join through campus or off-campus hiring as trainee or junior software engineers, usually after an online coding test and interviews. A small portfolio of projects on a public code profile helps candidates without campus placements.

value.title: At a glance
items: Service firms hire freshers in large batches; product firms hire fewer and test more.
Next roles: senior developer, tech lead, architect or engineering manager.
Hiring volumes rise and fall with the IT cycle.
